# Results (generated by tools/results.py from outputs/data/metrics.json; do not edit by hand)

Reference: net replacement fading from the 2018-2023 rate to the long-run rate (half-life 10 yr); 2026-2050; median demographics unless marked MC (joint uncertainty within the Reference). Carbon factors: A1-A3 of case-study items decarbonised 2026-2050 (Horup et al. 2025; item-level mapping, data/material_item_map.csv); A4-A5 e^(-0.01 (t - 2025)) (Resch et al. 2021); C1-C4, held items and soil carbon loss at 2025. Accounting: time-resolved (materials and construction (A1-A5) and soil carbon loss in the construction year; maintenance (B2, B4) in the year it occurs, 2026-2050; later B2/B4 and end of life (C1-C4) are committed after 2050, below).

## Planetary-boundary layer (AESA): climate change, 2 °C carrying capacity (Bjørn & Hauschild 2015)

## Maintenance 2026-2050 and committed after 2050 (deterministic, kt CO2e)

Committed after 2050: later maintenance events (B2, B4; lower bound: 2050 factors held; upper bound: 2025 factors) and all C1-C4 of the 2026-2050 cohorts (C1-C4 by material chemistry (Building_factors.C14_HELD_CLASSES): the carbon-bearing classes (timber, plasterboard, plastics, paint, SIP), whose end of life is the release of their own carbon at disposal, held at 2025 in both bounds; the energy part of the other classes (demolition, processing, transport) at 2025 factors in the upper bound and at the generic construction-stage factor e^(-0.01 (t - 2025)) (Resch et al. 2021) of 2050, held after it, in the lower bound); also in years of the 2050 AR boundary. Reconciliation with whole life at construction: outputs/reports/reconciliation.md.

## Single-lever reductions against the combined reduction (2026-2050)

The sum of the ten levers alone (Reference - Ln run) against the reduction of all ten together (Reference - Pathway or TL; pathways/runs.csv); overlap = 1 - combined / sum: the levers act on the same floor area and the same carbon per m2, so their effects are not additive.
